name: mediacleanuparr
description: Prune your Radarr and Sonarr libraries by TMDb audience rating, with a mandatory dry run. Scans movies and TV, flags titles below a user-rating threshold you choose, shows a dry-run estimate of the space that would be freed, and only deletes after you review the list and type DELETE. Extra tools: a "Biggest items" view to clear large titles you never watch, an "Empty / 0-byte cleanup" toggle (removes empty entries that are also below your threshold, plus orphaned empty folders), per-title "exclude from future scans", and optional Overseerr/Jellyseerr sync so deletions stop being auto-requeued. Defaults to DRY-RUN-ONLY and never deletes outside your media folder. Everything else — Radarr, Sonarr, TMDb (required), and optional Seerr URLs/keys, the threshold, and the safety switches — is configured in the web UI after the container starts and saved to /config.

paths.name: Config
paths.description: App data: database, logs, and deletion reports.

paths.name: Media
paths.description: Your media library. Mount it EXACTLY as Radarr/Sonarr see it so paths line up. Read-write is needed for empty-folder cleanup.

variables.description: Comma-separated media roots inside the container. Leave as /media unless you mount multiple media shares.
